{{Top|leg}}
The '''Valtava sector''' was a long-forgotten [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was the site of an [[asteroid field]] of billions of glowing red [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. Within the crystals lay a dormant and [[Valtava sector starship|immense starship]] of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] design that disrupted [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. Some of the crystals awoke with power when their bearer was in extreme danger.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=other|Item: "Crystal of Nightmare Fury"}}</ref>
